items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: When Buddy Bowden and them used to play... I was living on Short Street.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. So it's, what, what, where were you living then? I mean, uh, around that time, where did you live? I was living over here and living here and I was living around on Short Street. I see. When you built, when you built up Johnson Park I was living on Short Street. Like when, uh, when, when, when Buddy Bowden and them used to play Where Did You Live? Yeah. Where did you live? I was living on Short Street. On Short Street. On Short Street. It's right next to the park then. Right there for Johnson Park and…

The train, the train used to come down on a car and go to the Union Station. It was not a car then. There was a car then. There was a car then. There was a car then. A couple of years back. Because when he entered there, and then used to come, that thing, that's fixed. It comes there, uh, you know, a tripod in there. You put different things. Bridge and trees? Tree and... A car pastes. A car pastes. A car pastes the street. You come around to that. You see. And that's what's the big house right there. It's what I…
